verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Copilot code review can analyze PRs and suggest improvements directly from GitHub Mobile, directly matching the user story. Community evidence is dated/mixed on general app quality but doesn't concretely contradict this specific Copilot code review feature. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically testing the Copilot PR review feature on mobile, and detail on limitations of the AI suggestions themselves.
